title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Akira Tendo, a burned-out 24-year-old at an exploitative 'black company', greets a zombie outbreak in Tokyo as freedom and writes a list of 100 things to do before he turns. With his friend Kencho, the cautious Shizuka and the German fighter Beatrix, he crosses Japan ticking off wishes, meeting survivors and enemies, until an immune girl, Izuna, leads toward a vaccine.
life_message: It holds up living fully and joyfully now, with friends, rather than grinding one's life away for an employer.
